display.purpose: Hero promise and page titles only.

body.purpose: Paragraph copy, same family as display at regular weight.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, nav, tags, stats, timestamps — anything measured.

motion.name: ease-ui
motion.purpose: Default UI transition — fast, no overshoot (Linear-style).

motion.name: signal-core-drag
motion.purpose: The one licensed bounce/inertia in the system — hero 3D object only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Signal-teal fill CTA, e.g. 'See the projects'.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #5EEAD4; color: #0A0A0C; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; padding: 12px 22px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid #5EEAD4; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #34D1B8; border-color: #34D1B8; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5EEAD4; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; color: #9A9AA3; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; padding: 12px 22px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid #232327; transition: border-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #2E2E34; color: #EDEDED; }

components.name: Mono Tag
components.description: Stack tag / category label on project cards.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: #616167; border: 1px solid #232327; border-radius: 4px; padding: 4px 10px; }

components.name: Active Filter Chip
components.description: Selected category filter on the projects page.

narrative.overview: The prior site was a warm, editorial single-pager — cream/orange, particle dust, a soft 'personal blog' register. This redesign discards that register entirely: the visitor is admissions committees, hackathon judges, and recruiters who need proof of engineering range in under a minute, not a mood. The system reads as an instrument panel — a precise, dark, low-noise surface where the only saturated thing on screen is the signal it wants you to notice (a stat, a link, the one object you can pick up and turn). Density is restrained: generous vertical rhythm between sections, but tight, confident line spacing within them. Motion is fast and purposeful everywhere except one place — the hero's 3D signal-core — which is the site's single permitted moment of playful, physical, Bruno-Simon-style interactivity. Everywhere else, motion behaves like Linear: short, cubic, no bounce.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground with exactly one accent color, spent sparingly (Restrained strategy, not Committed/Drenched)
Two typefaces total: Space Grotesk (display + body) and JetBrains Mono (labels, data, tags, stats)
Flat by default — depth from layered near-black panels and hairline borders, never drop shadows
One signature 3D interaction (draggable signal-core); everything else is 2D and fast
Proof-first content: every claim sits next to a repo link, a stat, or a stack tag — never a bare adjective

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Teal never covers more than a small chip, button, or line at once. If a whole panel wants to feel 'active,' lift it with a hairline border and a faint teal glow at the edge — not a teal fill.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Only two typefaces exist anywhere in the system. If new UI needs a third register, it is expressed with weight, size, or case on one of the existing two — never a third font.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. The only elevation cue on hover/focus is a border-color shift plus, on the signal-core and primary CTAs only, a teal glow.

dos: Do spend Signal Teal only on things that are interactive, live, or measured (links, active states, stats, the signal-core).
Do keep every proof claim adjacent to a verifiable link, stat, or stack tag.
Do use JetBrains Mono for anything that is a label, tag, timestamp, or number; Space Grotesk for everything else.
Do let the signal-core be the only element with spring/bounce/inertial motion; keep the rest of the site on fast, cubic, no-overshoot transitions.
Do render QBoard (and any project with no live deployment) as a GitHub-link-only card — never fabricate a 'live' button.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent color, a gradient background, or a warm/cream tone — this is a Restrained one-accent system on purpose.
Don't add drop shadows for elevation; use border-lightening and glow only.
Don't use a third typeface anywhere, including in code snippets or footers.
Don't invent stats, testimonials, or capabilities not present in PRODUCT.md / the project data.
Don't let decorative motion (grid, particles, scanlines) exceed ~3-5% opacity or compete with content for attention.
